answers.core: This needs to be core because the engine makes the offset calculation internally, so doing it outside of core would be wasting an extra calculation just to undo to global offset.
answers.workaround: This is a very common use case for applying forces at non-origin locations, and it should exist to not confuse and frustrate new uses of the engine.

title: Add physics functions for `apply_force_at_pos` and `apply_impulse_at_pos` to apply a forces to a position in global space
